extracted.name: Moist Corn Muffins
extracted.description: Great recipe for Moist Corn Muffins.
instruction_lines: In a large mixing bowl Whisk together the dry ingredients.
In a small mixing bowl whisk the wet ingredients.
Pour the wet ingredients into the large mixing bowl containing the dry mixture. Mix until combined.
Spoon batter into 12 muffin tins - fill each one about halfway up (can use liners or spray with Pam)
Bake in preheated 400 degree oven 15-18 minutes
Serve warm for a special treat
